pages.text: Villages come in many styles (CTOV). Guards protect them, and bounty boards give jobs for rewards.$(br2)Ruins, towers, camps and dungeons are everywhere. Their chests have separate loot for each player.
Big dungeons (When Dungeons Arise, Cataclysm) are dangerous.$(br2)Spawners keep making mobs until you break them or light them up with torches.
pages.title: Be Careful
